checks.details: Window title pattern duplicated across 3 locations: The pattern `isDev ? 'SDD Orchestrator (dev)' : 'SDD Orchestrator'` for computing the base title appears in windowManager.ts (lines 199 and 463) and menu.ts (line 359). This should be extracted to a shared constant or utility.
evidence: electron-sdd-manager/src/main/menu.ts:359 - const baseTitle = isDev ? 'SDD Orchestrator (dev)' : 'SDD Orchestrator'

checks.details: Duplicate MetricsService/SpecManagerService creation in projectSetup.ts:setProjectPath() and windowManager.ts:createWindowServices(). Both paths create MetricsService (with MetricsFileWriter/MetricsFileReader) and SpecManagerService independently. During the transition period, the dual creation paths exist because setProjectPath() handles global state while createWindowServices() handles per-window state, but this will be a DRY concern once the migration is fully complete.
evidence: electron-sdd-manager/src/main/services/windowManager.ts:553 - metricsService: new MetricsService(logger, new MetricsFileWriter(logger), new MetricsFileReader(logger))

checks.details: WindowManager is correctly established as the SSOT for window lifecycle. All production code uses getWindowManager() for window operations. windowFactory.ts is deleted and all references removed.
IPCHandler follows Singleton pattern (DD-001). initializeTRPCHandler creates handler once and stores on WindowManager via setIPCHandler(). Subsequent calls attach windows via attachWindow().

MultiWindowState interface is duplicated in configStore.ts (line 81) and windowManager.ts (line 78). configStore version uses `bounds: WindowBounds` (readonly), windowManager version uses `bounds: WindowBoundsExtended` (mutable extends WindowBounds with identical fields). This is a minor SSOT violation - a single canonical type should be shared. Additionally, WindowBoundsExtended adds no new fields over WindowBounds (only removes readonly), which is a minor KISS concern.
evidence: electron-sdd-manager/src/main/services/windowManager.ts:34 - export interface WindowBoundsExtended extends WindowBounds { x: number; y: number; width: number; height: number; } (no new fields vs WindowBounds)

checks.details: Architecture follows a straightforward pattern: WindowManager -> WindowContextFactory -> tRPC Context. Event filtering uses a simple shouldDeliverEvent() helper. No over-engineering detected.
No speculative features detected. All new components (WindowContextFactory, EventBusFilter, IPCHandler Singleton) are directly tied to requirements.
windowFactory.ts is confirmed deleted. No file exists at src/main/windowFactory.ts. Only references remaining are in test files verifying the deletion (startupFlow.test.ts, index.test.ts).

index.ts correctly uses WindowManager.createWindow() via restoreWindows(), initializeTRPCHandler(), initializeMenuFocusTracking(). app.on('activate') and second-instance use WindowManager. No windowFactory references.
handler.ts exports initializeTRPCHandler (new) and setupTRPCHandler (deprecated with @deprecated tag). initializeTRPCHandler uses createWindowContextFactory as designed.
context.ts ContextServices interface includes optional windowId field. createContext merges overrides correctly.
projectState.ts correctly delegates to WindowManager for getCurrentProjectPath(), getSpecManagerService(), getAutoExecutionCoordinator(), getMetricsService(). Setters are deprecated no-ops.

watcherUtils.ts supports per-window watcher delegation via optional windowId parameter with backward-compatible global variable fallback. getAgentRecordWatcherService() removed (previously dead code).
events.ts router uses createEventSubscription helper with shouldDeliverEvent filtering. All subscriptions automatically filter based on window's projectPath. console.warn replaced with logger.warn.

menu.ts creates windows via getWindowManager().createWindow(). New window menu, recent projects, and focus tracking all use WindowManager. initializeMenuFocusTracking() registers onWindowFocus callback.
appLifecycle.ts cleanupOnQuit() calls windowManager.saveAllWindowStates() as the first cleanup step.
productionServices.ts wires createNewWindow via getWindowManager().createWindow(). showOpenDialog uses getFocusedWindow() with getAllWindows()[0] fallback.

windowContextFactory.ts created with createWindowContextFactory function. Used by handler.ts in production. Resolves window via BrowserWindow.fromWebContents(event.sender) with focused-window fallback.

eventBusFilter.ts created with PROJECT_SCOPED_EVENTS, APP_SCOPED_EVENTS constants, isProjectScopedEvent() and shouldDeliverEvent() helpers. shouldDeliverEvent is consumed by events.ts router in production.

[FIXED] getAgentRecordWatcherService() has been removed from watcherUtils.ts. Previously reported as dead code with zero consumers - autofix resolved by deletion.

APP_SCOPED_EVENTS is exported and consumed only in test files for event categorization completeness validation. PROJECT_SCOPED_EVENTS is used internally via projectScopedEventSet for O(1) lookup. Both serve valid documentation and test-verification purposes.
WindowContextCreateFn type is exported as the return type of createWindowContextFactory. Standard TypeScript API design for type-safe consumers.
setupTRPCHandler is deprecated (@deprecated tag) but still used in existing test files for backward compatibility. Acceptable during migration period.

No TODO, FIXME, PLACEHOLDER, or implementation-pending markers found in new/modified production files. Existing TODO/implement references in other files (updateManager.ts, etc.) are pre-existing and not part of this spec.

All new code uses projectLogger (aliased as logger) with structured logging. Log messages follow [Component] prefix pattern consistently: [WindowManager], [WindowContextFactory], [trpc], [projectSetup], [watcherUtils], [events-router].

Appropriate log levels used: logger.info for normal operations (window create/close, service init), logger.warn for recoverable issues (window not found, duplicate project, fallback, empty event data), logger.error for failures (tRPC handler init failure), logger.debug for verbose diagnostics.
